title: Convolutional Neural Network
description: Feed-forward neural network preserving spatial hierarchies with shared weights.
name: Convolutional Neural Network
summary: Convolutional Neural Networks preserve spatial layouts by applying mathematical convolution operations with small, localized feature detectors, sharing weights to learn translation-invariant representations.
use_when: Analyzing image data, spatial structures, or low-latency audio spectrogram features.
avoid_when: Working with tabular data or sequence text lacking local grid-like structural properties.
pros: Drastically reduces parameter counts compared to fully-connected networks.
Inherent translational invariance enables finding patterns anywhere in images.
Highly optimized GPU hardware implementations are universally available.
cons: Cannot capture global contextual relationships without very deep layer stacking.
Requires substantial data preprocessing like scaling, padding, and resizing.
Vulnerable to adversarial pixel attacks and shifts.

key_hyperparams.name: kernel_size
key_hyperparams.note: Height and width of the 2D convolution window. Common choices are 3 or 5.

quick_start:
import torch.nn as nn
import torch

conv = nn.Conv2d(in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=3)
x = torch.rand((1, 3, 64, 64))
out = conv(x)
